reviews.x: I was scared of the scent staying on my skin (i don't particularly enjoy the coffe smell) or that it was gonna be to harsh on my skin but it wasn't and no smell on me at all i enjoyed it a lot leaves skin very soft  i say give it a good shake before using it is quite gritty almost like wet sand so be careful not to drop some like me haha it has brown color but it stains me or my 🛁 a bit and leaves a bit of residue
I really like this coffee scrub! It has a pleasant smell and doesn’t leave a greasy residue. My skin feels so soft after using it. Definitely recommend it!

I love the way it leaves the skin feeling after using this scrub. The 1s use must of used a bit much felt like a layer of lard was rubbed on me. 2nd and 3rd uses used Lessard love it. For me at first I thought it was a little high priced but it is worth the$. I would recommend this srub.

As soon as I washed off the scrub I thought to myself, "omg I'm definitely reordering"! I've tried many different scrubs but none has left my skin feeling as clean, smooth, and glowing as this coffee scrub. I also love the sweet cocoa-y smell it has. I'll definitely be reordering!

I’d like to give 5 stars but I feel like the product contains more brown sugar than coffee. Best for sensitive skin !! I don’t like the smell but it’s alright. I don’t know about Disappearing  my cellulite skin yet. I hope it helps cellulite skin.  Soft enough  for daily use.

reviews.t: It’s an ok product super messy super oily
reviews.x: Can’t post a picture but yes this product is thick and grainy leaves you super oily so you gotta use a soap after
Skin felt really moisturized after exfoliating and the scent of the coffee was not to strong I was truly satisfied with this product.
I totally love this. It gently removes my dead skin and tighten it back to its inner glow. It left my skin so smooth and moisturized. I definitely recommend this to my friends.
Product works very well. I like how moisturized it leaves the skin. I will definitely buy it again.
This stuff is AMAZING!!! Never used this stuff and so glad I started!!! Skin is like silk after my shower!!! I do all my washing first then add this last!!
I don’t think this product is for sensitive skin since it can be a little rough. But on me for now it works fine used it 3 times already.

I like the smell and it is oily, first I feel a. Little bit annoy for oil but when I wake up next morning my skin is very moisture,I like it so much , I am going to buy again after I finished this one

I bought this item this week and within the first night of using it I wish I hadn't. It says it's 340 grams but compared to another product I bought on Amazon that has 230 grams, it's not near the same amount. The worst part of this product is the smell. It's smells like a combination of old people and chemicals. The texture isn't bad but there is way too much oil for this product to work properly. I wish I hadn't bought it. It was a waste of money.

I bought this on a whim to see if I could find something that will soften my skin and exfoliate at the same time. It worked so I will continue to use it. It leaves my skin nice and soft. Has a pleasant smell to it. It can be a little messy if your not careful taking it out of the jar but overall I have really enjoyed it.

This really does smell like coffee, can be a bit messy, but after you use it and touch the part of your skin that used the coffee scrub compared to another part of your body -- you can really feel a difference! I love that it is organic too!

So this product is a little messy.  Have not had it long enough to give it much of a good review, therefore all I can say for now is the smell it’s not to bad. I’ve only used it twice so far and my face feels clean and fresh.  Stay tuned!
The oil seeped out of the jar in shipping. The scrub looks too dry now. Used some anyway and it stained my tub
Love this!! Makes my skin glow and very moisturized!

reviews.t: Self-tanning product masquerading as an exfoliant
reviews.x: For several years, I have used Mountain Majestic Arabica scrub (available here on Amazon).  I obviously was quite pleased with it.  This past year, I decided to try some other brands of exfoliants - one was a store brand at a national beauty store (blah) and another that was actually a walnut shell-based product by a brand I like (nothing to write home about).  So I decided to go back to my old standard but saw this brand and it WAS a bit cheaper so I ordered it.  I first tried it on my face, ri

My friend recommended me to use grounded coffee for  exfoliation . So i searched coffee scrub on amazon  and came across to this product. First package came all oily . then i opened for use. ugh the nastiest feeling i've ever  experienced. It smells like recooked vegetable oil and it does not even exfoliate. It just applies weird oil  as if you took an oil shower. OMG i washed my body 4 times after the use to get rid of the oil and the smell. It still did not help. I applied body lotion , then p

It was sealed in shrink wrap, but the oils had leaked out of the container and the wrap causing oil to get on my other items that were shipped in the same box. Once I took off the shrink wrap I discovered that the foil seal was peeled off about 1/2 way. The product smells horrible, 100% like chemicals not even a hint of coffee. It has coffee extract. but that’s all. I had bought it as a gift, glad I checked it first. I wouldn’t trust it on my own skin, much less as a gift. Has a satisfaction gua

I have very sensitive skin due to my eczema but I also have mild shoulder acne and face acne so I was looking for a scrub that could work for my skin. This does the trick! Although my eczema doesn't fully go away this product does not irritate it at all and helps a lot with my acne and hydrating my skin. Many cleaners tend to over dry my skin but this leaves my skin feeling very hydrated and clean.

This scrub doesn't smell and doesn't looks like a coffee, smells like a chemicals. My skin was orange, my towel and bathtub stained on brown color! I was very scared when I saw brown bathtud and I was almost sure I destroyed it and I have to pay back money to landlord. I used a bleach to clean. Not recommended.

This makes my skin real soft, it's gentle. I used it a couple times and could see a difference in the texture of my skin, I usually put it on my dark spots and it looks like its fading with a couple of uses. I will continue using this. everyone needs an exfoliator and I believe this is one that everyone needs.

reviews.t: Not what I expected.. had to throw it away
reviews.x: Leaves residue after the shower that I have to extensively clean, stained my towel, doesn’t really have a coffee smell, and doesn’t exfoliate much. It moisturized, but I have oils that will do that without staining my towels and bath. Will not purchase again.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the scrub leaves skin very soft, smooth, and moisturized.
Many reviewers find the product messy and/or oily to use, sometimes requiring soap afterward.
Opinions on the scent are mixed: some enjoy the coffee/cocoa smell while others dislike it or find it too strong.
Several reviewers note the scrub can be rough or gritty, making it less suitable for sensitive skin.
A few reviewers question the value, citing price or amount concerns.
